commands.title: Authorize StyLuau to use GitHub API

styluau.releaseVersion.markdownDescription: The release version to install. This is overridden by `#styluau.targetReleaseVersion#`.
styluau.releaseVersion.markdownDeprecationMessage: This setting is deprecated. Use `#styluau.targetReleaseVersion#` instead, and the `StyLuau: Select Version` command.

styluau.targetReleaseVersion.markdownDescription: Target an exact StyLuau release tag. This overrides the version set by `#styluau.releaseVersion#`.

styluau.styluauPath.description: Specifies the path of StyLuau. If not specified, will automatically download one from the GitHub releases.

styluau.searchBinaryInPATH.markdownDescription: Search for the StyLuau binary in the `PATH` environment variable, and use this if available. If disabled, falls back to a bundled binary

styluau.disableVersionCheck.description: Disable checking the version of styluau for newer versions. Useful if you do not want network requests.

styluau.configPath.markdownDescription: Path to a `styluau.toml` configuration file. NOTE: this will override workspace configuration lookup

styluau.searchParentDirectories.description: Search parent directories for a styluau configuration file if one is not directly available.

styluau.verify.markdownDescription: Pass the `--verify` flag to StyLuau to enforce output verification

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
